summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the engine-free plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and the three thin handler adapters per the spec. Changed files: new monai/data/csv_saver.py and monai/data/nifti_saver.py; monai/data/nifti_writer.py (default dtype now np.float32); monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py (plot function added, existing GIF helpers untouched); monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py, classification_saver.py, tensorboard_handlers.py; renamed output_path to output_dir in examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_array.py, unet_evaluation_dict.py, and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Tests: new tests/test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; updated tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Static checks only: no lines over 120 characters, no trailing whitespace, no blank line at end of file. flake8 was not run. Documentation pages were not added (optional). Open risk: the classification handler's engine-accepting completion wrapper has not been verified against pytorch-ignite 0.3.0 signature checks, since the code was not executed.
